why.title: Why Vointy works
why.description: Every participant gets access to an app that encourages them to take part in physical activities and other leisure-related challenges on their own terms. They can invite friends to join, earn points, and stay motivated together. Activity levels can be tracked through an activity score, making it easy to compare progress and see how others are engaging. The variety of activities is wide, ranging from fitness to culture. At the same time, company leadership gains visibility into how employee activity and overall wellbeing are developing outside of work.

download.metaDescription: Install Vointy.life as a desktop or mobile app. Get the same experience without visiting the browser every time.
download.title: Get Vointy on any device
download.subtitle: Install Vointy.life as a Progressive Web App and access your wellbeing hub from your desktop or phone — no app store needed.

desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.description: Install Vointy directly from your browser for quick access from your taskbar or dock.
desktop.step1: Open vointy.life in Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
desktop.step2: Click the install icon in the address bar (a monitor with a down arrow) or select 'Install Vointy.life' from the menu.
desktop.step3: Launch Vointy from your desktop, start menu, or dock like any other app.
desktop.browsers: Works in Chrome and Edge on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.description: Add Vointy to your home screen for one-tap access.
mobile.ios: On iPhone or iPad, tap the Share button in Safari, then 'Add to Home Screen'.
mobile.android: On Android, tap the menu in Chrome and select 'Add to Home Screen' or 'Install app'.

benefits.title: Why install Vointy?
benefits.fast: Opens instantly from your home screen or desktop.
benefits.updates: Always up to date without manual updates.
benefits.space: Takes minimal storage space compared to native apps.

installPrompt.title: Install Vointy on your device
installPrompt.description: Add Vointy to your home screen for one-tap access to your activities.
installPrompt.iosDescription: In Safari, add Vointy to your home screen — it opens like a real app.
installPrompt.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
installPrompt.iosStep3: Tap "Add" — Vointy appears on your home screen.
installPrompt.androidStep1: Tap the menu (three dots) in Chrome.
installPrompt.androidStep2: Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
installPrompt.androidStep3: Confirm — Vointy appears on your home screen.
installPrompt.desktopStep1: Click the install icon in your browser's address bar.
installPrompt.desktopStep2: Confirm the install and open Vointy from your dock or start menu.
